start_here: Say to your AI: "Search what my coach teaches for grip." It finds the word in the lessons you hold and in the published articles, and answers each match with its lesson, a snippet and the second it is spoken.
no_lists_because: The search reads the school's own lessons, passages and articles through the engine for the learner who holds them; the person keeps no list of their own for this job.
instructions: 1. Give your AI the engine connection it already uses for your account; the school's coach must be set up for the school first.
2. Say "Search what my coach teaches for grip."
3. Read each match: its kind, its lesson id (none for an article), its snippet and its start second when it is spoken. Open the lesson with tool:read-a-lesson-i-hold for the whole of it.
